words.gloss: if the food eaten is digested

literal: If digested, completely having known, eat; that is the way for him who obtained a body to sustain it for a long time.
translation: Once the food previously eaten is fully digested, assure yourself of it and then eat; that is the way for one who has obtained a body to preserve it for a long time.
modern: முன் உண்ட உணவு செரித்ததை முழுமையாக அறிந்து உண்ண வேண்டும்; அதுவே உடம்பைப் பெற்றவன் அதனை நீண்ட காலம் செலுத்தும் வழியாகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the fundamental rule of health and longevity. One must eat only after ensuring that the previous meal has been completely digested. The phrase 'அற அறிந்து' emphasizes that one must be absolutely certain of this digestion before consuming more. Following this simple discipline is described as the ultimate way ('ஆறு') to sustain the physical body ('உடம்பு') and ensure a long, healthy life.
